process.subtitle: A data-driven, ROI-focused paid advertising process that maximizes every rupee of your ad budget — from setup to continuous optimization.

steps.title: Business & Goal Analysis
steps.description: We start by understanding your business, target audience, competitive landscape, and advertising goals. We audit your website for conversion-readiness and set up proper conversion tracking to measure every lead and sale.

steps.title: Keyword Research & Campaign Strategy
steps.description: We conduct deep keyword research to identify high-intent, high-value search terms your customers are using. We build a negative keyword list to prevent budget waste and map keywords to the right campaign structure.

steps.title: Ad Creation & Landing Pages
steps.description: Our copywriters craft compelling, high-CTR ad copies with strong headlines and clear CTAs. We also design or optimize dedicated landing pages to ensure maximum conversion rate from every click you pay for.

steps.title: Campaign Launch & Tracking Setup
steps.description: We set up your campaigns with precise audience targeting, bidding strategies, and conversion tracking. Every click, form fill, call, and purchase is tracked so we know exactly what's delivering ROI.

steps.title: Optimization & A/B Testing
steps.description: Once live, we continuously monitor performance — testing ad variations, adjusting bids, refining audiences, and pausing underperforming keywords — to progressively lower your CPC and increase conversion rate.

steps.title: Reporting & Strategy Refinement
steps.description: We deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports — impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, cost per lead, and ROAS — with transparent insights and a forward-looking optimization plan.

faqs.question: What is PPC and how does it work?
faqs.answer: PPC (Pay-Per-Click) is a digital advertising model where you pay only when someone clicks your ad. Your ads appear at the top of Google or on social platforms based on your bid and quality score. You set a budget, we optimize campaigns to get maximum clicks and conversions within that budget.

faqs.question: How much budget do I need to start Google Ads?
faqs.answer: You can start Google Ads with as little as ₹5,000–₹10,000 per month for local campaigns. For competitive industries like finance or real estate, we recommend ₹30,000–₹1,00,000+ per month for meaningful results. We help you determine the right budget based on your goals and competition.

faqs.question: How quickly will I see results from PPC campaigns?
faqs.answer: Unlike SEO, PPC delivers results immediately — your ads can appear and generate leads on the very first day of launch. However, optimal performance is typically achieved within 30–60 days as we gather data, test ad variations, and refine targeting for your specific audience.

faqs.question: Do you manage both Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. We manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. We recommend the right platform mix based on your business type, target audience, and goals.

faqs.question: What is ROAS and what ROAS can I expect?
faqs.answer: ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is the revenue generated for every rupee spent on ads. For example, 4x ROAS means ₹4 revenue for every ₹1 spent. Our average ROAS across campaigns is 4.5x, though this varies significantly by industry. We set realistic ROAS targets based on your specific market.
